cause_proximity_agreement.note: Agreement with a proximity proxy, not ground truth about cause: the frozen state of a neighbour is public in the message, the simulator does not expose which robot blocks which, and a clash flag is a decision event of the simulator. traffic and blocked_by_stuck agree with clash or other, blocked_by_faulted with frozen_neighbour, unknown with other.

truth_definition: truth stuck step = robot message t (not the last) with driving false, orderId non-empty and errors empty whose next message has the simulator stuck flag; truth episode = maximal run of such steps of one robot and one orderId, start = ts of its first message, end = ts of the message after its last, kept when end - start >= stuck_after
